step.label: Evaluate vendor material compliance
step.description: Validate incoming vendor invoices and material specifications against procurement and inventory standards.
step.useCase: Procurement teams need to ensure vendor-supplied materials meet quality and regulatory requirements before acceptance.

step.label: Assess customer safety campaign readiness
step.description: Review safety compliance requirements for customer accounts and associated campaigns to identify gaps.
step.useCase: Safety officers must verify that customer-facing campaigns meet all environmental, health, and safety regulations.

step.label: Enroll workforce in safety programs
step.description: Identify and assign employees to occupational health and safety training based on organizational hierarchy and role requirements.
step.useCase: HR and safety teams need to ensure all employees across departments receive mandatory safety program enrollment aligned with their roles.

step.label: Orchestrate production changes for material updates
step.description: Coordinate engineering changes and material updates across production systems when new compliant materials are approved.
step.useCase: Manufacturing operations must synchronize production schedules and engineering changes when validated vendor materials are introduced.

step.label: Execute occupational health campaign deployment
step.description: Deploy safety and health awareness campaigns to employees and customer accounts using coordinated engagement strategies.
step.useCase: Safety program managers need to disseminate occupational health requirements and track employee engagement in real time.

step.label: Analyze safety performance metrics and compensation impact
step.description: Correlate employee safety compliance with performance data to inform compensation and incentive decisions.
step.useCase: Sales and HR leadership need visibility into how safety program participation affects individual and team performance.

step.label: Coordinate vendor contract safety obligations
step.description: Manage vendor contracts and purchase orders to embed safety compliance clauses and material specifications.
step.useCase: Procurement and vendor management teams must ensure contracts include binding safety and material quality commitments.

step.label: Optimize customer safety campaign targeting
step.description: Refine customer segmentation and campaign messaging to maximize safety awareness and compliance adoption.
step.useCase: Marketing and CX teams need to target high-risk customer segments with tailored safety messaging for maximum impact.
